note: ketonet passim (also Joseph's robe, Gen 37:3) is probably a robe reaching to the palms and soles, a long-sleeved robe. "Divers colours" follows the Septuagint's guess in Genesis.

kjv: And the soul of king David longed to go forth unto Absalom
mine: And the spirit of the king longed to go out to Absalom
note: wattekhal dawid is grammatically awkward (feminine verb with "David"). It may mean "longed for" or "ceased (from going out against)". Both versions supply a subject. The sense, longing or hostility, is debated.
